item.title: Russia-Linked Hackers Used New Mesh Network Backdoor in Destructive Ukraine Attack
item.description: Sandworm and UAC-0099 carried out a destructive wiper attack on a Ukrainian logistics company in 2025, using a new mesh network backdoor, per ESET research. Shows state actors using OT-adjacent destructive tooling against critical infrastructure supply chains. (Source: The Hacker News)
